rationale: The pain is real but highly infrequent — most ISVs encounter the non-deterministic 'expression too long' error only during occasional package upgrades, not as a recurring workflow blocker. Evidence volume is thin: the single Stack Exchange post with no upvotes or follow-on discussion suggests this is a niche edge case rather than a widespread, frequently-felt pain. No willingness-to-pay signal exists — there are no competitors charging for this, no job postings seeking this skill, and no community requests for a paid tool. The global addressable market of ~3,000–5,000 AppExchange ISVs is too small to justify building even a lightweight micro-product.
